name: scene-export-simple
description: Simple ladder for whole-scene 3D export (Q-3DEXPORT). Verifies the sceneExport3d flag is OFF in Simple mode and ON in Pro; that the Tools menu shows the GLB/OBJ export items in Pro; and that clicking Export 3D model (.glb) runs the full pipeline (live scene -> buildExportRoot -> GLTFExporter -> download) and fires the success toast.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: sceneExport3d should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: sceneExport3d should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: verify-glb-item-present
steps.failMessage: Export 3D model (.glb) menu item not found in Pro Tools menu

steps.name: verify-export-success-toast
steps.failMessage: Export pipeline did not fire the success toast (live scene -> buildExportRoot -> GLTFExporter)

steps.name: build-usdz-bytes
steps.eval: (async () => { const root = (await import('/src/scene/sceneExportAccess.ts')).getSceneRoot(); const { buildExportRoot } = await import('/src/export/sceneGltf.ts'); const er = buildExportRoot(root); const { exportSceneUsdz } = await import('/src/export/sceneUsdz.ts'); const bytes = await exportSceneUsdz(er); window.__usdzBytes = bytes.byteLength; })()
